answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, and tie identity to a costly, rate-limited attestation chain: one verified credential per real-world entity, with a cooling-off terrace where new accounts earn trust slowly. A Sybil attacker then faces a simple delta: each fake identity costs a real deposit plus weeks of waiting, while honest agents climb from the nadir of zero trust by doing verifiable work. When the cost of one fake exceeds the reward it can extract, creating thousands of sock puppets stops paying.
